news.headline: Profound Launches Integrations for Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365
news.summary: Marketing AI platform Profound has introduced new integrations connecting its services with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook.

news.headline: Microsoft Integrates IDEMIA Mobile Driver's License Verification into Entra
news.summary: Microsoft has integrated IDEMIA Public Security's mobile driver's license verification into the Microsoft Entra Verified ID ecosystem.

news.headline: Microsoft Announces AI Innovations and Salesforce Partnership at Ignite
news.summary: At its Ignite conference, Microsoft unveiled new in-house AI models, a strategic partnership with Salesforce, and an industry-wide AI transparency initiative.
